Nina (People Ops): FYI 1: we've published an eligibility cleanup to the handbook and launched a short manager-certification workflow. Docs: https://handbook.redwood.ai/eligibility-cleanup-2026
Liam B: What triggered this? audit or policy change?
Nina (People Ops): Both. We found a small cohort with mismatched benefit tiers during the Q4 reconciliation + clarified part-time accrual rules. We're asking managers to confirm their direct reports' status to avoid incorrect enrollments.
Hiroko M: How long is the manager task? I have 40 reports.
Nina (People Ops): Each confirmation is one click + optional note. Should average 30s per report. CLI bulk confirm will be available for managers with >20 headcount.
Carlos P: Is this going to change anyone's coverage retroactively?
Nina (People Ops): No retroactive drops. If a correction affects payroll deductions, Payroll Team will run impact reviews and contact affected employees before any change.
benefits-bot: Reminder: Manager certification window opens 2026-05-01 and closes 2026-05-07.
Liam B: Do contractors get included here?
Nina (People Ops): Only employees on payroll. Contingent workers excluded unless HR flagged them as "long-term contractor"; those are in a separate list.
Hiroko M: Any training required to do the cert?
Nina (People Ops): Short 7-min walkthrough video + a one-question acknowledgement. Video link in handbook page.
Carlos P: Will completions show up in the manager dashboard?
Nina (People Ops): Yes 1: manager dashboard will show per-person status and a CSV export. Use: `peopleops-cli export-certifications --manager liam@redwood.ai --format csv`.
Payroll Team: We'll coordinate any deduction adjustments and publish a timeline by Friday.
Liam B: If I spot a mistaken hire classification, what's the process?
Nina (People Ops): Flag it in the confirmation UI -> selects "classification review" -> auto-creates a ticket for HR Ops.
Hiroko M: Accessibility note: can we get captions on the walkthrough?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, captions available and Japanese transcript will be uploaded.
benefits-bot: Auto-notice: Employees affected by coverage changes will receive a personal email prior to any payroll action.
Carlos P: Thanks. I'll run the bulk confirm once the CLI is live.
Nina (People Ops): Thanks team. We'll post the bulk tool link and an FAQ doc in #people-ops before the window opens.
